blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: byRef — Pass a reference to original.
readLine — Read the next file line.

blocks.title: Use exact indexing
blocks.text: OCR arrays use zero-based indexing; the number in array declaration is the number of elements.

blocks.title: Trace subroutines and parameters
blocks.text: A procedure does not produce a return value; a function returns a result. byVal passes a copy; byRef allows the original parameter to change.

blocks.title: Read file operations
blocks.text: openRead, readLine, endOfFile and close follow the OCR Appendix 5d conventions. Always close an opened file.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Array declaration creates three positions: indexes 0,1,2.

questions.feedback: byRef — Pass a reference to original.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: The parameter is passed by reference, so assignment to x changes the caller's n.

blocks.title: Check reasoning
blocks.text: After addOne(n), n=7 and print displays 7.
